title: A low surrogate escape before a high surrogate escape
notes: A surrogate escape names a character only as half of a pair: a high surrogate escape directly followed by a low surrogate escape (RFC 8259 section 7, the kit's reading in the pair case). Any other surrogate escape encodes no character (RFC 8259 section 8.2) and is refused. YAML 1.2.2 does not settle this (section 5.2 counts every code point as a character), so the case rests on a convention. Loose mode needs any error; strict needs the syntax category. Here the low surrogate comes first, so neither half belongs to a pair.

provenance.reference: A decoder that accepted a surrogate escape that is not half of a pair and produced an invalid string or a replacement character.
